scenarios.hypothesis_summary: Mr Abiodun Castellanos was already in the storeroom fetching paper when Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito, using card C-017, entered and Another colleague, using card C-041, entered shortly afterwards. The two entrants confronted Mr Abiodun Castellanos together about a missed deadline; during the struggle Mr Abiodun Castellanos was shoved against the grey cabinet, sustaining the forehead and shoulder injuries. Mr Soren Blackwood-Ito left visibly at the later storeroom exit, with Another colleague leaving close with that exit unrecorded as a separate card event, and Mr Abiodun Castellanos later got out to the corridor where Ms Clementine Alvarenga found him.

supporting_facts.text: CCTV and access logs place a C-017 entrant and then a C-041 entrant entering the storeroom in quick succession and the door then staying closed.
Mr Abiodun Castellanos said he went to fetch paper, Another colleague came in after him, they argued about a missed deadline, it became heated and he was shoved hard into the cabinet edge.
A faint thud and then raised voices were recorded while the storeroom door remained closed.
Blood was found inside the storeroom door and on the cabinet edge, with scattered paper boxes, an overturned chair and a pulled-forward shelf concentrated near the door.
The medical findings of a forehead laceration and shoulder bruising are consistent with a fall against a hard edge, though they do not prove the mechanism.
Ms Clementine Alvarenga later found Mr Abiodun Castellanos sitting against the corridor wall, bleeding and dazed, and called emergency services.
